correctness.rationale: The 12 rational-coordinate unit vectors have off-diagonal inner products -9/11 (twice), -5/11 (twice), -1/11 (four times), 7/11 (three times). Via the spherical addition theorem the exact-degree harmonic evaluation rank equals that of Gram G_l=[P_l(u·v)]. An independently written modular Legendre recurrence and 12x12 exact mod-1000000007 elimination recomputed all l=0..324, producing ranks [1,3,5,7,9,11,9,12,...,12], and checked G_6(a=2) nonsingular; no package verifier output was accepted without reconstruction. The independent low-degree witness basis and formula give an upper bound 9 at l=6, while the mod-prime lower bound 9 proves exactness. At l>=325 the Laplace integral gives |P_l(x)| <= sqrt(pi/(2l))/sqrt(1-x^2); rational lower bounds on sqrt(1-x^2) produce total weighted off-diagonal row sum <18/sqrt(l)<1, so G_l is strictly diagonally dominant and nonsingular for every l>=325. Since det G_6(a) is a nonzero rational function (nonzero at a=2) with zero at a=3, its root at 3 is isolated. Finite certification is precisely degrees 0..324; the all-higher claim relies on the analytic bound.
